report.summary: Build and runtime smoke succeeded in a temp copy; plugin loads, ESLint run passes, and CLI help executes without errors.
reasoning: `npm ci` completed successfully; `prepare` reported non-git directory and skipped husky without failing.
`npm run build` (`tsc -p tsconfig.build.json`) completed with no errors.
`npm run smoke:runtime` passed, confirming the built plugin can load in ESLint and the CLI responds to `--help`.

improvement_path.item: Make the `prepare` step a no-op in non-git environments (explicit guard or `HUSKY=0` guidance) to remove the install-time warning.
improvement_path.rationale: Eliminates noisy but non-fatal output that can be misinterpreted as a failure in clean temp copies or CI.

improvement_path.item: Add a dedicated `start` or `run:smoke` script that chains `build` + `smoke:runtime` for a single execution health check.
improvement_path.rationale: Simplifies baseline runtime validation and reduces the chance of skipping required build before execution.

improvement_path.item: Document minimal runtime requirements (Node version + ESLint peer dependency) in a short execution-health section.
improvement_path.rationale: Clarifies prerequisites to prevent avoidable runtime failures when consumers attempt to execute the plugin.

testing.summary: Jest suite runs cleanly with strong coverage and extensive @supports traceability annotations across unit and integration tests; remaining risk is concentrated in lower-branch helper paths.

report.summary: Jest suite runs cleanly with strong coverage and extensive @supports traceability annotations across unit and integration tests; remaining risk is concentrated in lower-branch helper paths.
reasoning: `npm test` passes (57 suites, 543 tests) indicating stable execution across rule, utility, maintenance, config, and CLI integration coverage.
Coverage is high overall (96.82% statements/lines, 98.36% functions, 86.75% branches) and configured global thresholds are met.
Tests are behavior-focused (RuleTester valid/invalid cases, CLI integration via spawnSync) with readable assertions and traceability-tagged cases.
@supports annotations are pervasive (234 occurrences), enabling strong requirement/story linkage across tests.
Branch coverage is still weak in several helper modules and entrypoints, leaving some conditional logic under-exercised.

improvement_path.item: Add targeted branch-path tests for low-coverage helpers and entrypoints (e.g., `src/index.ts`, `src/rules/require-traceability.ts`, `src/rules/helpers/prefer-implements-inline.ts`, `src/rules/helpers/require-test-traceability-helpers.ts`, `src/utils/function-annotation-helpers.ts`, `src/utils/branch-annotation-switch-helpers.ts`).
improvement_path.rationale: Improves confidence in conditional logic paths that are currently under-exercised.

improvement_path.item: Add a lightweight end-to-end smoke test that runs the plugin against a small fixture project via the CLI.
improvement_path.rationale: Adds full-stack confidence beyond current integration/unit coverage.

improvement_path.item: Populate `traceability.byStory` from @supports annotations to explicitly report per-story coverage gaps.
improvement_path.rationale: Makes requirement coverage visibility stronger and more actionable.
